notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.10 is a reliability release for the hand-offs between the browser, the app and the engine. "Download Later" no longer loses the download: the folder, timing and size chosen in the browser now travel with it, instead of the app opening a dialog whose closing threw the download away after the card had already said "Queued in NDM". The extension-update notice can be trusted again — the app now learns the extension's version from its download messages too, not only when it happens to check in. Cancel means cancelled: the card waits for the app's answer and, if a cancel fails, restores its buttons and keeps watching instead of claiming success. A video whose merge was interrupted — by a power cut, say — now restores as paused and is verified when it resumes, instead of being marked Finished on its file length alone. Deleting a download waits for the engine to truly settle instead of racing it after five seconds, and Pause All now requeues downloads that are starting or merging, not only ones already running. Videos start sooner: the format picked in the picker is warmed at pick time rather than resolved a second time at start, and resolving is bounded at 45 seconds with a working fallback instead of an indefinite hang. Finished downloads' connection rows now read "Done", the stale zero-byte .ndm.lock files left in the download folder are swept, and a failed portable update now relaunches the restored copy and leaves a note of the failure instead of leaving nothing running. 2.0.10 is a required update for older versions.
